mapper.sql: rt.id, rt.rule_code, rt.target_type, rt.priority, rt.is_primary, rt.target_code as target_code, coalesce(m.id, mp.id) as target_id, coalesce(m.model_code, mp.name) as target_name, coalesce((select lm2.model_type from kb_provider_model_mappings pm2 join kb_logical_models lm2 on lm2.model_code = pm2.logical_model_code where pm2.model_id = m.id and lm2.is_deleted = 0 order by pm2.id asc limit 1), lm.model_type) as model_type, m.provider_account_code
mapper.select: select from kb_routing_rule_targets rt left join kb_models m on rt.target_type = 'MODEL' and rt.target_code = m.model_code and m.is_deleted = 0 left join kb_model_pools mp on rt.target_type = 'MODEL_POOL' and rt.target_code = mp.pool_code and mp.is_deleted = 0 left join kb_logical_models lm on lm.model_code = mp.logical_model_code and lm.is_deleted = 0 where rt.rule_code = #{ruleCode} order by rt.priority asc, rt.id asc
mapper.insert: insert into kb_routing_rule_targets(rule_code, target_type, target_code, priority, is_primary) values(#{ruleCode}, #{targetType}, #{targetCode}, #{priority}, #{primary})
